consequence.statement: Controller-assigned IPs now respect per-proxy DNS capture settings consistently with ephemeral auto-allocated IPs; previously they handled DNS capture differently.

original.statement: A bug fix ensures controller-assigned proxy IPs honor per-proxy DNS capture configuration the same way ephemeral auto-allocated IPs do.

decision.reason: [ev-37215a11e33d] only says a bug was fixed: controller-assigned IPs now respect per-proxy DNS capture the same way ephemeral auto-allocated IPs already did. That is a runtime behavior change. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs migrating, so an action kind isn't supported. Because the behavior does change, "none" would understate it. behavior-change (review) is the strongest kind the evidence supports. The note gives no sense of operator impact, so the medium severity is not grounded in the evidence, which is why confidence is low.
